single_factor: actor update credit per eligible actor replay transition only; critic credit .5 fixed, no LN/lr/n-step/safety changes
budget_review: Huber is the retained first SAC candidate; increased actor credit is the second candidate. No third candidate or rescue in this group. Critic UTD=1 from the broader plan is deferred to avoid changing two rates together.
failure_policy: Retain all failures/aborted attempts and costs. Do not evaluate an aborted checkpoint. No replacement evaluation/retention starts. No outcome-driven reruns.
decision: Descriptive paired development comparison of accepted updates, frozen task progress/completion/falls, flat eligibility and MAE. One seed/start cannot qualify G1 or establish significance; never choose an earlier best checkpoint.
